subject: Re-engage: MAP and updated timeline — welcome Tom as new champion
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@finovative.com>, Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@finovative.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re-engage: MAP and updated timeline — welcome Tom as new champion

Hi Tom and Alicia,

Hope you both had a good week. I wanted to re-open our MAP conversation and introduce Marissa (cc'd) who will be our delivery lead on the account going forward. We understand there was a pause while the champion role transitioned — Tom, welcome to the project and thanks for stepping in.

Quick recap of where we left off: Finovative had completed an initial eval but paused during the org reorg. Per our last sync, open items were security evidence (SOC2 excerpts), a short pilot (2-week perf/latency check), and procurement/PO.

Proposed next steps (high level):
- 1) Security docs delivery — Redwood provides SOC2 excerpt and data handling summary (this week)
- 2) Pilot window scheduling — agree on a two-week window for workload replay and latency targets
- 3) Commercial alignment — finalize pilot pricing and procurement path
- 4) Executive check-in — short sync after pilot to decide go/no-go

I attached an updated MAP spreadsheet with suggested owners and dates. Marissa, can you propose a concrete 6-week timeline that accounts for Finovative's procurement windows? Tom / Alicia — please flag constraints (budget windows, holidays, legal review queues).

I'll book a 30-min kickoff next week once we have a target week for the pilot.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving again.

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
[Attachment: Finovative_MAP_v2.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)]
[Attachment: SOC2-excerpt.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@finovative.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@finovative.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-engage: MAP and updated timeline — welcome Tom as new champion

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the concise plan and the intro. A bit about my context here: I was promoted into the head of Data Platform two weeks ago and will be the internal owner for vendor evals going forward. My priorities are: security/compliance, predictable latency under production workload, and predictable cost.

Constraints to call out now:
- Procurement has a budget freeze until April 20 (we can get pilot sign-off but not long-term commitments until the freeze lifts)
- We need SOC2 evidence and a short data flow diagram passed to our security team for review (they typically provide feedback within 5 business days)

I reviewed the attached MAP quickly — looks reasonable. Two requests:
1) Can we push the pilot start to the week of April 26 so procurement constraints don't block resources?
2) Please include a short success criteria section in the MAP (latency P95 <= 300ms for common TX, accuracy checks on 1k prompts).

I'll introduce a couple more stakeholders once procurement constraints are clearer (cc'ing Alicia who handles vendor contracting).

Tom
Tom Hsu
Head of Data Platform | Finovative
tom.hsu@finovative.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@finovative.com>, Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@finovative.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-engage: MAP and updated timeline — welcome Tom as new champion

Tom — welcome again. Thanks for the clarity on timing and success criteria. I updated the MAP (attached) to reflect: pilot week of Apr 26–May 7 (two-week active period plus 3 business days for results), owners for each row, and explicit success criteria (latency P95 target, throughput, and qualitative accuracy checks).

Highlights of the updated MAP:
- Week of Apr 12: Security review window — Redwood provides SOC2 excerpt + data flow diagram (we'll upload to your shared Drive link)
- Week of Apr 19: Technical prep and test data handoff (Dev will help with replay script)
- Apr 26–May 7: Pilot execution window (Dev-run workload replay, monitoring with Redwood Console)
- May 10: Pilot results review + exec decision

Open asks for Finovative:
- Confirm that Apr 26 pilot window works operationally for your infra team
- Share any redline requirements from legal/procurement up front so we can triage them early

I've attached the revised MAP as Finovative_MAP_v2.xlsx and included a short checklist in the sheet called "SuccessCriteria." Dev, can you confirm the replay script will be ready by Apr 19?

Thanks — will schedule a 30-min kickoff for Apr 14 to walk through the updated plan unless you prefer another date.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (206) 555-0212
[Attachment: Finovative_MAP_v2.xlsx (Excel, 60KB)]

From: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@finovative.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@finovative.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Apr 2027 15:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-engage: MAP and updated timeline — welcome Tom as new champion

Marissa/Tom,

Thanks for the update and the clear timeline. Procurement note: our finance team will accept a pilot SOW and a short PO for the pilot period. I attached our standard PO template and an explanation of our internal approval flow. The budget freeze lifts Apr 20; after that we can route a pilot PO within 5 business days if the SOW is final.

Two items from our side:
- Please send the data flow diagram and SOC2 excerpt to security@finovative.com (they asked for a single email thread)
- We have a required attestation about data retention for pilots — I've added a short clause we generally request (see PO_template.docx)

I'll plan to join the Apr 14 kickoff if it's scheduled.

Regards,
Alicia Romero
Vendor Contracts Manager | Finovative
alicia.romero@finovative.com | +1 (415) 555-0255
[Attachment: PO_template.docx (DOCX, 28KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@finovative.com>, Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@finovative.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-engage: MAP and updated timeline — welcome Tom as new champion

Thanks all — great alignment. Short actions from Redwood:
- We will email SOC2 excerpt + data flow diagram to security@finovative.com today (expected delivery by EOD)
- Dev will confirm replay readiness by Apr 19
- Marissa will send calendar invite for Apr 14 kickoff (30 min) to walk through MAP and success criteria
- We will review Alicia's PO template and incorporate the data-retention attestation into the pilot SOW

Tom/Alicia — if any other stakeholders should be on the kickoff, please add them to the invite. Otherwise we will proceed with Apr 14 and the pilot window of Apr 26–May 7.

Appreciate the quick turnaround here. Looking forward to getting the pilot running.

--
Karthik
